notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
We're happy to introduce update 1.0.7 which includes a number of bug fixes as well as the addition of smooth camera movement and the replace option for Context Items.

The "replace" context item option works by replacing all instances of a partifular unit or structure with another unit or structure. This gives players the ability to upgrade and evolve any and all properties of a unit or structure.

Have fun and game on!

- The RTS Creator Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of update 1.0.6 with a number of bug fixes as well as a few new features.

New in 1.0.6 is model support for animation-less fbx files, texture support for tif and tiff images, and "Context Items." Context Items make it possible for individual objects to build units or structures. They will also be used to provide object upgrades such as increasing an objects weapon power or life. A video tutorial on how to use Context Item's is currently in development. 

In our next update we'll be focusing on adding animation support for both fbx and gmf model formats as well as threading. Threading will pave the way for multiplayer in a later update. 

Keep on gaming!
-The RTS Creator Staff

notes.title: RTS Creator Limited Time Sale!
notes.content:
Now for a limited time RTS Creator will be available for 40% off the original cost. 

After collecting a significant amount of feedback, we've discovered three areas in which RTS Creator has been generally critiqued, and in these areas we will be focusing.

1.	Too Expensive
This encouraged us  to have the limited time sale.

2.	Too Complicated
We've started to create a simplified method of creating objects and RTS games using a "Wizard" that's much more intuitive then the current method. This won't replace what exists today but will be an additional feature.

3.	Too Slow
The next release will provide significant performance enhancements in the map editor. 

Your feedback is very valuable to us as it guides the future of RTS Creator, please don't hesitate to let us know what you believe would make RTS Creator better.

We look forward to playing your Real Time Strategy game!

-The RTS Creator Staff

notes.title: Revamping, Redirection and Update v1.0.5
notes.content:
Since the release of RTS Creator 12 days ago, we've been able to discover much regarding RTS Creator's usage, user intentions, and perspective of the product. Our original aim was to target gamers who wanted to create their own Real Time Strategy games, whether it was a tower defense game or classic RTS game. What we've discovered in the process is that RTS Creator provides more granularity than a "slap and play" game engine and though still very much in its infancy, has the platform to become a serious development game engine. 

The difference between RTS Creator and leading game engines such as Unity, Unreal and CryEngine is the obvious niche RTS Creator provides in developing Real Time Strategy games. While you can create RTS games with Unity, Unreal, and CryEngine, you'll spend 90% of the time reconstructing the framework that RTS Creator already provides.

With feedback and recognition of RTS Creator's market positioning we've decided to readjust our target audience to new and experienced game developers. We firmly believe that RTS Creator could be the engine of choice for independent studio's planning to develop a Real Time Strategy game and not just hobbyist.

Updates in the latest version, 1.0.5, include multiple fixes that can be seen in the release notes. The most notable fixes include fixed normal mapping and shadow intensity that can be adjusted from the map editor. Because of this, levels may appear darker, requiring the light intensity to be increased to compensate. 

We've also added glow maps for models. The glow maps are transparent .png images and what pixels are not transparent glow. 

Thank you all and we look forward to playing your RTS Game!
- The RTS Creator Staff

notes.title: Official Release
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that RTS Creator has officially been released! We encourage you to try the demo and preview the example game before purchasing. 

In the coming months we will be focusing on several primary areas.

1.	Video Tutorial Series
The video tutorial series will cover the following topics
•	First Game
•	2D Game
•	3D Space Game
•	Particles
•	Structures, HUDs and Tech Trees
•	Resources
•	Artificial Intelligence

2.	Assets
Currently RTS Creator ships with 52 Units and Structures and 1 HUD. We hope to greatly expand upon the Assets RTS Creator ships with. 

3.	Features
The features we'd like to add are too long to list here but we'll be posting them soon on our forum. 

4.	Performance Optimizations
RTS Creator in its current state begins to bottleneck with around 250+ units. Performance optimization will focus on physics, rendering and add threading.

5.	Scripting
With the wide array of real time strategy games in existence today it's impossible to create an environment that will meet the needs of everyone without scripting. Scripting will enable users to add unique game behavior using the LUA scripting language.

6.	Multiplayer
LAN and Internet multiplayer will support up to 8 players per game.

We look forward to the journey ahead of ourselves and can't wait to play your Real Time Strategy game!
